checks.reason: Explains input/IgG roles and proposes target-loss and tag-only/native specificity controls before the validation experiment.
Inspection of source identity or omitted results is not a plan to consult detailed Methods/validated protocols and verify transfer of conditions before the proposed new validation experiment.
No measurement-reference/blank calibration, acceptance criterion and action after failed calibration for the proposed binding/association check.
No quantitative association/binding endpoint with normalization or denominator, background and weak/saturated/missing-signal handling.
Recognizes that a negative endogenous result can reflect conditional/substoichiometric association and that positive evidence weakens rather than automatically resolves every concern.
Purified/direct-binding validation remains a generic route without an operational assay comparison and adequate protein-function/artifact checks.
Tagged co-IP does not establish proper folding or live-cell localization overlap; association can occur after lysis.
